definitions.wireSchemaGenerated: Parameter/result shapes exist; this does not imply implemented browser semantics.
definitions.unsupported: No supported behavior is declared. A known schema never implies command success.
definitions.partial: A handler implements documented behavior with remaining semantic limitations.
definitions.implemented: The manifest declares implemented behavior; tests are evidence, not a claim of complete Chrome equivalence.
